subject: [PATCH 3/3] mm/page_alloc: disable IRQs around the remaining pcp drains

2026-11-25.patch_summary: This patch disables interrupts around the remaining pcp drains in the Linux kernel's page allocation code to prevent potential deadlocks caused by interrupt handlers running while holding the pcp lock. The patch introduces a new macro, `pcp_spin_unlock_nopin_irqrestore`, which saves and restores the interrupt flags when dropping the pcp lock. This change is particularly important for systems with many CPUs, as it reduces the likelihood of deadlock situations. The patch has been tested on a 128-vCPU guest and has shown significant improvements in performance by reducing the frequency of fallbacks to the TLB remove table RCU callbacks.
